entries: When une créature that can see Kyrilla's eyes starts its turn within 30 mètres of her, Kyrilla can force it to make a {@dd 14}jet de sauvegarde Constitution if Kyrilla isn't {@conditionincapacité} and can see la créature. Si  saving throw fails by 5 or more, la créature is instantly {@condition pétrifié}. Otherwise, une créature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is {@condition entravé}. The {@condition entravé} creature must repeat the saving throw at la fin de son prochain tour, becoming {@condition pétrifié} on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until la créature is freed by the {@spell greater restoration} spell or other magic.

Unless {@status surprised}, une créature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If la créature does so, it can't see Kyrilla until the start of its next turn, lorsque it can avert its eyes again. If la créature looks at Kyrilla in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

Kyrilla's accursed gaze does not affect undead or constructs. If Kyrilla sees herself reflected on a polished surface within 30 mètres of her and in an area of bright light, she is, due to her curse, affected by her own gaze.
